name: Gourmet Delight B.B.Q.
source: no reliable menu source (Yelp and candidate domains checked in a real browser session 2026-09-22)
notes: No official website (gourmetdelightsf.com is a registrar parking page). Yelp has no menu page for this business (the /menu URL redirects to the business page, which lists popular dishes by name only: BBQ pork, roast duck, soy sauce chicken, fried chicken, chow mein, chow fun, rice box). The only third-party listing with prices (allmenus) carries implausibly stale per-pound prices and is not used. Yelp hours: 8am-6pm daily. Counter-service roast-meat shop; prices are posted in-store only.
